body:
Mobile menu looks a bit too... spacy :)
![2015-11-09\_09h57m24](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/283419/11029598/5c6d47b8-86c8-11e5-8447-caaedcf1a7ca.gif)

I would not split the content in two columns that early (800px?). On small screens, each column is really narrow. It is more readable to put text and examples one below the other until we really have a a bigger screen (maybe when we start adding the menu column? 1200px?)

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/283419/11029668/cc03626a-86c8-11e5-9c07-1da435ed6eff.png)
